svg.title: An external account, limited to the epics it is given — SoftTrack web design mockup (#243)
svg.desc: An invitation can mark the person as outside the organisation and name the epics they may see. Such an account sees those epics’ tickets and nothing else on the team, has no directory, teams or expense claims, and carries an External chip wherever its name appears.
svg.text: An external account, limited to the epics it is given
· outside the organisation is something an account is

g.text: Settings → Engineering → Members, signed in as Amina
Admins can invite people, change roles and remove members. Guests can see everything on the team and change nothing.
This person is outside the organisation
No directory, no team of their own, no expense claims. Marked External wherever their name appears.
No epic chosen means no tickets.
Could the invoice list show the purchase order

svg.text: Done when external is set on the invitation or by a site admin and never by the person, an external account gets no directory, departments, workload, team creation, expense
claims or ideas inbox, an external guest sees only the epics it was given and no epic means no tickets, the chip shows beside the name everywhere, and a sweep test sends every
